items.title: 'Nothing off the table': Police update on search for four-year-old Gus leaves more questions than answers
items.description: Police declared the disappearance of Gus Lamont a major crime due to "a number of inconsistencies and discrepancies" emerging during the four-month investigation.

items.title: I have a question for the men who had no questions about Epstein
items.description: The millions of pages of documents related to the late convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein have shone a light on how many influential men were ready to disregard the experiences of countless women.

items.title: Underworld figure Tony Mokbel a free man after drug case abandoned
items.description: Prosecutors have abandoned a drug trafficking case against underworld figure Tony Mokbel following his release from prison last year.

items.title: France says Australia-bound drug ship isn't its problem after letting crew free
items.description: French authorities intercept a ship carrying five tonnes of cocaine bound for Australia, before releasing the vessel and its crew.

items.title: Judge criticises Abbott's 'misconceived' comments over harbour bridge protest
items.description: The former prime minister said it should not be for judges to decide when a political protest was justified, which are remarks NSW's top judge called "regrettable".

items.title: Live: Nationals put counteroffer to Ley, propose two weeks on the backbench
items.description: The Nationals have proposed spending another two weeks in exile from the frontbench rather than address the Liberals' non-negotiable conditions for a Coalition reunion. Follow live.

items.title: Writers festival 'crazy' to invite Randa Abdel-Fattah, NSW premier says
items.description: The festival's director said Dr Abdel-Fattah was invited in August last year and denied the state government pressured her to remove the writer.

items.title: Terror charge over Invasion day attack sends shock wave and reveals rifts
items.description: It will take time and significant effort to repair relationships with the Indigenous community amid the fallout from last week's attempted bombing in the Perth CBD — but other growing rifts in society will be even harder to mend.

items.title: Tropical Cyclone Mitchell expected to form off WA's Pilbara coast
items.description: The Bureau of Meteorology says Tropical Cyclone Mitchell has a high chance of forming into a category two system, bringing destructive winds and heavy rain to northern WA.

items.title: Indonesian teachers paid $170 per month as education funds go to free meals
items.description: Temporary teachers in Indonesia paid low wages criticise a government decision to direct one third of yearly education funding to the president's flagship free meals program.

items.title: 'I think we are there': Warning over US military build-up in the Middle East
items.description: Ahead of planned nuclear talks between the United States and Iran, satellite imagery reveals how the US is positioning itself for potential military escalation.

items.title: Minneapolis man charged with threatening, cyberstalking ICE officers
items.description: A 37-year-old activist has been arrested for what the US Justice Department says is cyberstalking and threatening to kill or assault ICE officers involved in the crackdown in Minnesota.

items.title: 'Head on a block': Former ADF member charged over alleged threats to PM
items.description: The court heard the posts included phrases such as "I want your head on a block Albo" and "I want permission to claim your head".

items.title: Live: ASX opens lower, RBA governor addresses economics committee
items.description: The ASX has opened lower, while RBA governor Michele Bullock addresses the economics committee. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: How sport isolated, then helped to heal Bláthnaid following a violent rape
items.description: How sport was both healing and isolating in the aftermath of a violent sexual assault for Irishwoman Bláthnaid Raleigh.

items.title: 'My heart stopped': Valuable Pokemon cards stolen from Canberra store
items.description: The owner of Collectors Colloseum in Canberra says he believes about $150,000 worth of trading cards was stolen overnight.

items.title: Music offered these incarcerated women hope. What happened after prison?
items.description: Creative prison programs are celebrated for their ability to heal and transform incarcerated people. But are they enough to break the cycle?

items.title: 'Every single person is on guard': Minneapolis's week of chaos after killing of Renee Good
items.description: Renee Good and her wife moved to Minneapolis "to make a better life" with their six-year-old son. But just over two minutes into an encounter with ICE agents she was fatally shot.

items.title: End of US-Russia nuclear weapons pact 'could not come at a worse time'
items.description: The last remaining nuclear arms pact between Russia and the United States has expired after Donald Trump rejected an offer from his Russian counterpart.

items.title: US wants world to follow Australia into 'club of nations' to counter China
items.description: The US is urging dozens of countries to follow Australia's lead and sign on to a plan to stop relying on China for the critical minerals used in modern technology.

items.title: Louvre releases photos of squashed crown abandoned by jewel heist gang
items.description: The thieves who robbed the famed Paris museum last October dropped the diamond and emerald-studded crown as they escaped, leaving it crushed and broken.

items.title: ATO debt continues to drive record level of calls to financial helpline
items.description: Financial counsellors say small businesses struggling to pay debts owed to the tax office are driving calls to Australia's Small Business Debt Helpline higher.

items.title: Charge upgraded for Tim Picton's alleged killer
items.description: The man accused of a one-punch attack on former Labor strategist Tim Picton, who died in hospital last month, has his charge upgraded to manslaughter.

items.title: Everything you need to know about the 2026 Milano Cortina Winter Olympics
items.description: Australia is tipped for enormous success over the next couple of weeks so now might be a good time to clue yourself up. Here's everything you need to know about the 2026 Winter Games.

items.title: Ocean rescues spark calls to focus on 'life-saving skills' in swimming lessons
items.description: The high-profile rescue of a Perth family swept out to sea in WA's South West sparks calls for a focus on teaching survival skills, rather than perfect technique, to young swimmers.
